text:
[LFCA.6.1] Fine-grained control over `call` for tiers wanting stricter
rate discipline than the default. A construct whose capability the program's
resolved settings set `false` is refused ([LDIA.3.4.2]).

| Name | Explanation | Depends on | Refactor hint |
|---|---|---|---|
| `nocooldown` | the bare `nocooldown` flag on `call`, for naturally-bounded calls ([LCRS.8.1]) | `call` | use an explicit minimum numeric cooldown instead. The tier has disabled the opt-out, forcing every call to declare a real rate bound. |
